name: Yamaha V Star 250 / Virago 250
intro: A small, simple V-twin cruiser. One carb and chain drive. Most problems come from sitting.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. A small number of 2019 V Star 250s are in recall 20V212 because an oil passage in the engine side cover may not be drilled.
A-002.reason: Without that passage the engine can starve of oil and seize. The fix is free.

recalls.what: An oil passage in the right engine cover may not be machined, starving the engine of oil.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the engine side cover free.
